theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ψ : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid P) (V Y : Set (Euclid (n + 1))), IsOpen V → ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → InjOn ψ V → (∀ y ∈ V, Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ y)) → MeasurableSet Y → IsCompact (closure Y) → closure Y ⊆ V → (∀ p : Euclid P → Prop, (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n + 1].restrict (ψ '' Y)), p x) → ∀ᵐ y ∂(volume.restrict Y), p (ψ y)) ∧ ∀ w : Euclid P → Euclid P, IntegrableOn w (ψ '' Y) μHE[n + 1] → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n + 1].restrict (ψ '' Y)), ∀ y ∈ Y, ψ y = x → w x ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ y : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P)) → ∃ W : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid (n + 1), Integrable W ∧ (∀ y, y ∉ Y → W y = 0) ∧ ∀ ℓ : Euclid P → (Euclid P →L[ℝ] ℝ), ∫ x in ψ '' Y, ℓ x (w x) ∂μHE[n + 1] = ∫ y, ℓ (ψ y) (fderiv ℝ ψ y (W y))
